text: Irakli Kobakhidze - Just like the Prime Minister, the State Minister will also be served by the entire resources of the government administration, there is nothing wrong with this, although the opposition manages to speculate here too - this is their nature and is not interesting (28.04.2026, 16:17)

Just like the Prime Minister, the Vice Prime Minister, and the State Minister for Coordination of Law Enforcement Agencies will be served by the entire government administration's resources - as you can see, there is nothing shady here, although the opposition manages to spread speculation here too - this is their nature and it is not interesting, - Prime Minister Irakli Kobakhidze told journalists.
According to him, the goal of creating a new structural unit is to further strengthen the law enforcement system.

"These changes served to further strengthen the law enforcement system. A new link emerged - the link of coordination. Mamuka Mdinaradze had performed this function before, but from a specific agency. This was the actual situation. We decided to formalize the given situation, which is correct, which had been established before. In reality, there will be independent structures. Naturally, these are the Ministry of Internal Affairs, the State Security Service, the Special State Protection Service, and they will ensure their overall coordination. The new position of State Minister is intended for this, which will further strengthen the fight against crime and care for the protection of public order. You know that during this year we have had fundamental changes in all directions," Kobakhidze said.

In addition, the Prime Minister responded to a question about the parallels between the imprisoned former head of the State Security Service, Grigol Liluashvili, and Mamuka Mdinaradze, noting that "the processes were conducted differently then, and they will be conducted differently now."

"The commitment is radically different. The context is completely different. Mamuka Mdinaradze is an exceptionally successful member of our team. Specifically, his work in the State Security Service was exceptionally successful, including in the direction of corruption, in the direction of terrorist crimes. He implemented very important systemic changes. This is a different background, therefore, future development will also be different in a different background," Kobakhidze said.

The Parliament will consider an accelerated draft law on the basis of which the position of State Minister for Coordination of Law Enforcement Agencies will be introduced within the Government of Georgia. According to the draft, the activities of the new State Minister will be provided materially, technically and organizationally by the Government Administration.

According to the Parliamentary Secretary of the Government, Vakhtang Bachiashvili, the powers of the State Minister will be specified in a government resolution. According to him, the State Minister for Coordination of Law Enforcement Agencies will be located in the Government Administration Building.
